load_rouge_metric: load the rouge metric from the huggingface evaluate library for text evaluation
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive gradio widget for the loaded rouge metric
evaluate_rouge_scores: evaluate rouge scores for predicted and reference text pairs using the loaded module
compute_rouge_metrics: compute rouge-1, rouge-2, and rouge-l metrics for summarization evaluation
run_rouge_evaluation: run rouge evaluation on model-generated summaries against reference texts
